cases.note: The field names one object in blob storage, and `under` names the place the row's own bytes live in: {ownerUserId} is the row's own owner. An account export copies the object only when its key lies strictly inside that place.

`tree`: the field names a prefix, and the bytes are every object under it; {id} is the row's own id. `counted`: the bytes are counted in the file's report and never carried. Either takes a list of strings as well as a string, and both still name their place.
